notes.title: Small bug fix
notes.notes:
I believe I've determined what was causing the textbox to freeze for some people! It was the little in-text pauses after punctuation. I still have no idea *why* this broke some people's textboxes and not others, but I've commented the code that handled the pauses, so the 'wait' function is empty now. This also means the text now scrolls a bunch faster, which some people will be happy with.

I've never been able to replicate the problem myself, so I can't personally test if I've fixed it. I've had to rely on people from the internet to track down the problem and test the solution. So, hopefully it's fixed, but if it isn't then uhh... >w<

Also, check out ABASHONJE! Part 1 is out now! I'm not linking it, but I believe in your capability of finding it.
